source: C. M. Wilson, G. Johansson, A. Pourkabirian, M. Simoen, J. R. Johansson, T. Duty, F. Nori, P. Delsing, 'Observation of the dynamical Casimir effect in a superconducting circuit', Nature 479, 376-379 (2011); arXiv:1105.4714
location: Main text and figure captions of arXiv:1105.4714 (the paper contains no Table 1; per-quantity locations below). Filename follows the canonical example in experiments/README.md.
comment: Verbatim transcription from the arXiv full text (fetched 2026-08-31). The paper states several values as approximate ('~'); such values carry a note. Consumed by Layer 5 (vacuum.floquet); loaded and unit-converted only through vacuum.experiments_io.

pump_frequency_fig2c.location: Fig. 2c caption; also used in Fig. 3 ('The drive frequency is 11.30 GHz')

pump_frequency_scale.note: stated as approximate: 'modulating the inductance of a SQUID at high frequencies (~11 GHz)'

drive_band.location: main text (drive range for the 4-6 GHz analysis band)

effective_boundary_velocity_fraction.note: stated as approximate: effective boundary velocity 'approaching v/c ~ 0.05 for a 10% modulation of the SQUID inductance' (fraction of vacuum c)

line_speed_fraction_of_c.note: stated as approximate: 'c0 ~ 0.4c is the speed of light in the transmission line' (fraction of vacuum c)

sample_temperature.note: 'The sample is cooled to 50 mK in a dilution refrigerator' — the line temperature for thermal-occupation estimates

thermal_occupation_at_reference.note: 'thermal photon occupation number of n = 0.008 at 5 GHz' (at the 50 mK sample temperature); used as a published cross-check of this loader's temperature conversion

thermal_occupation_reference_frequency.note: frequency at which n = 0.008 is quoted

amplifier_noise_temperature.note: stated as approximate: cryogenic HEMT amplifier system noise temperature T_N ~ 6 K
